QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_25

question.text: Ms. Priya Shah is planning a SAS-200 engagement for Swasth Bharat Trust, which runs a rural health camp programme in Vidarbha. Which sample of secondary data would be MOST appropriate to obtain at the preliminary entity review stage under Section 5.7.3?

answer.text: Only the Trust's audited balance sheet
A customer-satisfaction NPS survey from the donor community
Only the SE's last Annual Impact Report

Legal identity and objectives of the SE, project timelines, key managerial personnel, geographical regions, policies, governing board details, plus project monitoring framework, baseline/midline/endline reports, and fund-utilisation certificates

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 5.7.3 lists preliminary entity review indicative points (legal identity, projects/timelines, KMP, geographies, policies, governing board) AND separately lists social objective/impact overview (stated project objectives, project monitoring framework, baseline/midline/endline reports, closure report, fund utilisation certificate, details of vendors / third parties). A thorough preliminary review covers BOTH sets. The Trap: A (only balance sheet) is financial-audit thinking. C (only last AIR) is too narrow. B (NPS survey) is marketing-speak and not part of entity review. Cross-Exam Context: NISM X-A / X-B (IA) uses preliminary-due-diligence lists; XXIII's list is specific to SEs and includes baseline data — a concept absent from investment-adviser pre-engagement work.
